name: text-3d-flip
blurb: Text flips in 3D space, revealing alternate text.
description: Animates text with a 3D flip effect on hover or scroll, showing different content on the back face.
use_when: Toggle interactions or revealing alternate information.
avoid_when: Hidden content — flip may prevent discovery.
a11y: During flip, text is not readable. Keyboard users may not trigger hover.
